data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 integrates SRC_004's OOD-probe requirement into its abstention framework: the cross-distribution evidence that SRC_002 demands is operationalized by SRC_004's adversarial probes, so a single evaluation with adversarial items becomes a bounded sample of the deployment distribution rather than one narrow point — a necessary but insufficient step toward the generalization-expected-accuracy verdict. It is refuted if adversarial probes within a single evaluation are proven fully sufficient to establish cross-distribution reliability, dissolving the need for the broader abstention.
